title: 第3章 太虚造化树九枚道果第4章 灵魂镇压一眼秒杀
slug: 无敌帝祖第620章一剑杀了
content_zh:
远处的天边，朝阳逐渐升起，漫天赤红色云霞。
弘丰城街道，也开始变的喧嚣起来，熙熙攘攘的人群。
林毅却脸色苍白，神情萎靡。
此事对他的打击很大。
“义父，你放心吧，我现在无法冲开灵脉，兴许哪天就冲开了。”
林晨扶着林毅，感受到对方的神情，脸上浮现出笑意。
他内心很清楚，马上就满十六年了。
到那个时候，太虚造化树的第一枚先天道果就会成熟，他就可以借助先天道果开脉。
林毅苦笑着摇摇头，明显不信，他只当是林晨在安慰他。
“大衍皇朝百年前最强者罗浮，十八岁才成功开脉，传闻他获得一缕游离天地间的意念，进入顿悟状态，冲破灵脉。”
“可，那几率真的太小了。”
“唉！”
林毅满脸苦涩的摇摇头，一声叹息。
“就算无法开启灵脉，大不了我就像上古时期的强者，走炼体之道。”
林晨一边开导林毅，一边在弘丰城的街道走着。
他的双眸深处，却浮现出一抹寒意。
“哼。”
他虽然将自己的修为和意念以及传承，散落在天地间。
可是，他的灵魂在无穷无尽的虚空之中，锤炼了十万年，才凝聚出来的道胎。
虽然他还没有开脉，他的灵魂感知能力，却远超常人。

自从离开林府后，他就感知到有人跟踪。
若是连一点保命手段都没有，他也不敢散尽前面九世的成就，转世轮回修炼第十世。
“炼体之道？”
“传闻上古时期，人类的身躯能够突破极限，一根手指足以移山填海。”
“炼体之法无比珍贵，怕是只有那些顶尖势力才有。”
虽然这十多年，林晨拼命磨炼肉身，身躯确实比同龄人强悍不少。
他却根本不相信，有人能够走炼体之路。
林毅面色更加难看，炼体之路号称是九死一生。
林晨很清楚林毅执拗的性格，也不再多言，索性转移话题。
他与林毅连夜赶路，清晨才到弘丰城，现在也已经饥肠辘辘了。
“义父，我们吃点东西，补充食物，再赶路回天元镇吧。”
林晨看向街边的热气腾腾的面馆，肚子也忍不住咕噜响起。
“就这家吧，看着人挺多的，味道应该不错。”
林毅这才想起来。
他是融血境巅峰武者，两三天不进食无所谓。
content_en:
In the distant horizon, the morning sun gradually rises, filling the sky with crimson clouds.
The streets of Hongfeng City also began to become noisy, bustling with people.
However, Ji Yi looked pale and looked depressed.
This incident hit him hard.
"Father, don't worry. I can't break through the spiritual veins now. Maybe one day I will."
Lin Chen supported Lin Yi, feeling the other person's expression, and a smile appeared on his face.
He knew very well in his heart that it would be sixteen years soon.
By that time, the first innate Dao fruit from the Taixu Creation Tree will mature, and he can use the innate Dao fruit to open his veins.
Lin Yi smiled bitterly and shook his head, obviously not believing it. He just thought it was Lin Chen comforting him.
"Luofu, the strongest person in the Dayan Dynasty a hundred years ago, successfully opened his pulse at the age of eighteen. It is said that he received a ray of thought that wandered between heaven and earth, entered a state of enlightenment, and broke through his spiritual veins."
"But, the chance is really too small."
"Alas!"
Ji Yi shook his head with a bitter look on his face and sighed.
"Even if I can't open my spiritual veins, at worst I will be like a strong man from ancient times, following the path of body refining."
Lin Chen enlightened Lin Yi while walking on the streets of Hongfeng City.
There was a hint of coldness in the depths of his eyes.
"Hmph."
Although he scattered his cultivation, ideas and inheritance across the world.
However, his soul had been tempered in the endless void for a hundred thousand years before condensing the Tao embryo.
Although he has not yet opened his pulse, his ability to perceive souls is far beyond that of ordinary people.
Ever since he left the Lin Mansion, he had sensed that someone was following him.
If he didn't even have any means to save his life, he wouldn't dare to undo his achievements in the previous nine lives and reincarnate to practice in the tenth life.
"The way to refine your body?"
"It is said that in ancient times, the human body could break through the limits, and one finger could move mountains and fill seas."
"The body-refining method is extremely precious, and I'm afraid only the top forces have it."
Although Lin Chen had worked hard to hone his physical body for more than ten years, his body was indeed much stronger than his peers.
But he didn't believe at all that someone could take the path of body refining.
Ji Yi's face turned even uglier. The road to body refining was said to be a narrow escape from death.
Lin Chen was very aware of Lin Yi's stubborn character, so he stopped talking and simply changed the topic.
He and Lin Yi traveled all night and arrived at Hongfeng City early in the morning. They were already hungry.
"Father, let's eat something, replenish food, and then rush back to Tianyuan Town."
Lin Chen looked at the steaming noodle shop on the street, and his stomach couldn't help but growl.
"Let's just go to this one. There are quite a lot of people there, so it should taste good."
Only then did Lin Yi remember.
He is a peak warrior in the Blood Fusion Realm, so it doesn't matter if he doesn't eat for two or three days.
